B1_B_PATCH_PLAN.problem_statement: TOOL-01 and GAK operate as parallel authorities in BrainSession.chat(). TOOL-01 pattern router executes before GAK natural-language policy evaluation, creating potential for policy inconsistency when intent classification differs between pattern matching and semantic analysis.

patch_options.name: GAK preflight before TOOL-01 execution
patch_options.description: Insert evaluate_action_policy check inside _tool01_router before executing or requesting permission. This makes TOOL-01 a consumer of GAK policy rather than a parallel authority.
patch_options.risk: Low-Medium. Could break TOOL-01 if policy evaluation has side effects or changes return format. Needs careful integration to preserve existing permission_required and allow_once/allow_session flow.
patch_options.benefit: Ensures all TOOL-01 actions are subject to GAK policy evaluation. Reduces parallel authority risk without major refactor.

patch_options.name: Document TOOL-01 as separate governed authority
patch_options.description: Add inline comments and documentation clarifying that TOOL-01 has its own permission system and that GAK is a secondary policy layer.
patch_options.benefit: Reduces confusion for future maintainers. No architectural risk.

patch_options.name: Full TOOL-01 migration into GAK policy engine
patch_options.description: Move all TOOL-01 pattern matching, permission logic, and execution into governed_action_kernel.py, making GAK the single authority.
patch_options.risk: High. Major refactor touching 145+ code points. High probability of breaking existing TOOL-01 behavior, permission flows, and UI integration.

preferred_patch_scope.behavior_change: TOOL-01 actions will now be blocked by GAK policy before execution. Existing permission_required flow preserved. No UI changes.
preferred_patch_scope.rollback_plan: Before applying B1-C, create an explicit timestamped backup of tmp_agent/brain_v9/core/session.py under tmp_agent/b1_routing_authority_audit/backups/. If rollback is needed, restore that exact backup by copying it back over session.py after verifying checksum and line count. Do not use git checkout/reset/clean.

required_tests: test_tool01_write_permission: verify GAK blocks write to protected paths even when TOOL-01 pattern matches
test_tool01_read_permission: verify GAK blocks read from protected paths even when TOOL-01 pattern matches
test_governed_action_kernel: verify no regression in GAK behavior
acceptance_criteria: New test: TOOL-01 pattern match on protected path is blocked by GAK before permission request
New test: TOOL-01 pattern match on safe workspace still works with permission_required
No changes to TOOL-01 UI button behavior
No changes to allow_once / allow_session / deny flow
